stem: A line remains phenotypically uniform after many passages, but no provenance or passage history was retained. What is the strongest quality concern?
choices: Visual uniformity alone cannot replace traceability and appropriate fidelity evidence for long-term germplasm confidence
The line is proven genetically stable
Passage history is irrelevant if plants look alike
Cultivar name is sufficient identity evidence
rationale: Fidelity assessment depends on provenance, passage history and fit-for-purpose evidence; appearance alone cannot establish complete genetic identity.
